name: Cannabis Neuroadaptation
scope: CB1 plasticity, potency, chronic exposure, state-dependent learning, effort allocation, autonomic state, commercialization and environmental-system interaction.
primary_question: What exposure transitions changed physiology, and what systems can observe, reinforce, model or exploit the resulting states?
boundary_notes: Do not infer intentional population conditioning without separate evidence.

name: Methamphetamine, Synthetic Supply, and Physiological State
scope: Industrial supply transition, price compression, purity/adulteration, neuroadaptation, sleep deprivation, autonomic/thermal signatures, behavioral visibility, procurement and enforcement incentives.
primary_question: How did the supply transition change physiological states, visibility, predictability and institutional responses?
boundary_notes: Separate supply, physiology, institutional response, and intent.

name: Mirrors and Reflective Interfaces
scope: Spectral reflection/absorption, polarization, coatings, vibration, laser vibrometry, structured light, NLoS sensing and thermal behavior.
primary_question: When does a reflective surface become a sensing, transmission, filtering or actuation interface?
boundary_notes: Separate measured optical properties from metaphor and folklore.

name: LED and Controlled Illumination
scope: Semiconductor emitters, drivers, spectra, flicker, modulation, visible-light communication, structured illumination, camera support, circadian effects and smart-light networking.
primary_question: What secondary sensing, communication and actuation capabilities accompanied the lighting-efficiency transition?
boundary_notes: Separate regulatory rationale, technical affordance, deployment and intent.

name: Lead Paint, Walls, and Building-Material Transitions
scope: Paint chemistry, plaster/drywall, metal lath, insulation, foil, reinforcement, coatings, windows and frequency-specific propagation before and after renovation.
primary_question: Did modernization alter residential electromagnetic, optical, thermal or vibrational permeability?
boundary_notes: Study complete assemblies; do not reduce to a universal claim that lead pigment blocks RF.

name: Wi-Fi Channel State Information
scope: Occupancy, motion, respiration, gait, gesture, localization, identity inference, through-obstruction sensing, IEEE 802.11bf and edge processing.
primary_question: How did communication infrastructure become a distributed environmental sensing field?
boundary_notes: Track laboratory, product, standard and deployment stages separately.

name: Thermal and Infrared Visibility
scope: Temperature distribution, circulation, stress correlates, inflammation, respiration, presence, sleep/activity, transmission and inference limits.
primary_question: Which physiological states are externally visible in infrared and under what conditions?
boundary_notes: Do not equate laboratory classification with reliable emotion identification.

name: Contactless Optical Physiology
scope: Remote photoplethysmography, respiration, HRV, oxygenation estimates, gaze, pupillometry, micro-movement, illumination, compression and identity linkage.
primary_question: What involuntary physiology can cameras extract, retain and connect to identity?
boundary_notes: Log capture constraints and error modes.

name: Radar, RF, and Through-Barrier Sensing
scope: Doppler, phase, time of flight, UWB, mmWave, respiration, cardiac micromotion, posture, occupancy, gesture and through-wall signs of life.
primary_question: Where are contactless RF capabilities operational, integrated and retained?
boundary_notes: Range and resolution must be frequency- and environment-specific.

name: Mathematics of Convergence
scope: Observability, controllability, coupling, stability, state estimation, sensor fusion, inverse problems, causal graphs, temporal convergence, capability-disclosure gaps and coupled human-AI stability.
primary_question: When do independent capabilities become an operational closed loop rather than a coincidental collection, and when does declared state diverge from functional state?
boundary_notes: Public scope excludes protected formulas, weights, thresholds and proprietary implementations.

name: Smart Power, Meters, and Electrical Infrastructure
scope: Appliance disaggregation, occupancy inference, power-line communication, drivers, inverters, harmonics, control and data retention.
primary_question: What behavior and occupancy become visible through electrical infrastructure?

name: Acoustic, Ultrasonic, and Vibrational Systems
scope: Microphones, speakers, ultrasonic signaling, ranging, acoustic scene analysis, solid-surface vibration and vibrometry.
primary_question: How do ordinary sound and solid surfaces become sensing or signaling channels?

name: Windows, Glass, Coatings, and Selective Transmission
scope: Low-emissivity glass, conductive coatings, tint, smart glass, RF/IR transmission, reflection, shielding and visibility.
primary_question: How did window and coating transitions alter selective access to signals?
boundary_notes: Closely linked to building-material and thermal trunks.

name: Algorithmic Media and Closed-Loop Stimulus Systems
scope: Adaptive feeds, recommendation, reinforcement, state-aware delivery, digital signage, behavioral feedback, feedback capture and human-algorithm control topology.
primary_question: When does measurement-driven personalization become a state-responsive actuator loop?
boundary_notes: Separate general engagement optimization from physiological-state targeting and separate functional consequence from intent.

name: Mobile, Wearable, Vehicle, and Smart-Building Sensor Fusion
scope: Phones, watches, earbuds, vehicles, thermostats, cameras, microphones, inertial sensors, location and physiological-shadow modeling.
primary_question: Which multimodal systems construct persistent state models tied to identity?
boundary_notes: Integration trunk; retain links to component trunks.
